title: 30 in 100 exposed against 10 in 100 unexposed
caption: The risk is 3/10 against 1/10, so RR = 3. The odds are 30/70 against 10/90, so OR = (3/7)/(1/9) = 27/7 ≈ 3.86, larger than the RR because the disease is not rare.
alt: Two bars of ten cells: the exposed bar has 3 shaded, the unexposed bar 1.
description: Exposed: 3 in 10 (30 in 100) develop the disease.
